messages:
anya (Marketing): Heads-up: uploaded the next draft of the launch blog to Drive: https://drive.redwood/launch-v4. Need a quick alignment pass on: 1) audience hooks (PM vs infra), 2) safe benchmark language + methodology link, 3) webinar CTA & lead routing rules. Short replies pls. :eyes:

cal (Product): Skimming. My take: put a 1-line PM opener at the top, then an infra highlight card with the numbers. Also include a tiny features->buyer mapping table so landing pages can route messaging.

ravi (Growth): Agreed. Use a single HubSpot form but set a hidden `audience_segment` field via URL param. Example snippet below. We'll route to different workflows based on that hidden field.

tess (Design): I'll build two hero copy variants and a compact table asset for the post. Also can make the CTA microcopy swap on the header based on `?seg=` param.

june (Legal): Redline: avoid absolutes. Use "up to" and name the baseline (e.g., "NVIDIA A100 40GB baseline"). Must link to the benchmark file and include a 2-line methodology blurb: model family, sequence length distribution, batching config, hardware. Add short disclaimer under numeric claim.

anya (Marketing): Ravi 1 drop the HubSpot snippet here and the workflow IDs. Cal 1 can you draft the PM TL;DR (1-2 lines) and the benchmark line we can use that matches Legal's asks?

ravi (Growth): HubSpot form (single form, hidden audience_segment): ```html
<form action=\"https://forms.hubspot.com/submit/launch123\">
  <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"lead_source\" value=\"launch_blog_2026\">
  <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"audience_segment\" value=\"__SEG__\"> <!-- pm or infra -->
  <input name=\"email\" type=\"email\" required />
  <button type=\"submit\">Reserve webinar seat</button>
</form>
```
We'll set __SEG__ via `?seg=pm` or `?seg=infra`. Workflows: PM -> wf_642_pm_launch; Infra -> wf_642_infra_launch. Tag signups with `launch_2026_batchB` and add utm_source=blog to links.

cal (Product): PM TL;DR: "Ship LLM features faster 1 Redwood removes serving friction so product teams ship production-ready prompts, routing, and monitoring in days, not months." Benchmark sentence: "Internal tests show up to 25% lower per-token latency vs NVIDIA A100 40GB baseline and up to 30% lower per-request GPU cost (internal benchmark, May 2026; see methodology)." I'll add a 2-line methodology box in the doc.

june (Legal): That phrasing is ok provided the benchmark doc link is included and the methodology box lists: model family (open-family X), typical seq len (128-512 tokens), batching strategy, hardware used (NVIDIA A100 40GB), and that Dedicated/Private results may differ. Also include: "Results may vary by workload and deployment."

tess (Design): Webinar seats = 275. Ravi, can seat-bot flip the CTA to "Join waitlist" at 250? I'll make the waitlist CTA a distinct amber color and add a tiny capacity indicator under the header CTA.

seat-bot: Configured: seat_threshold=250, hard_cap=275. Will post counts to #marketing at 200, 250, and when full. Will emit a CMS hook when threshold reached to swap CTA copy.

anya (Marketing): One more ask: can we map the hero variants to the tracking param? e.g., `?seg=pm` -> hero A + CTA copy "Reserve webinar seat for product teams"; `?seg=infra` -> hero B + CTA "Reserve infra benchmark seat". Also include a tiny table in the post mapping features->buyer for comms: ```
Observability & rollouts -> Product managers
Dedicated capacity -> Infra/platform teams
Private deployments -> Regulated enterprises
```

cal (Product): Added that table into the draft and linked the benchmark doc.

ravi (Growth): I'll wire up the HubSpot hidden-field logic and the workflows. Seat-bot will post live registration counts. Also will ensure incoming leads are auto-tagged with the utm and segment field.

june (Legal): Final: add short disclaimer under numeric claim: "Results from internal benchmarks; actual results may vary based on workload and deployment." After that I'm good for copy lock.

anya (Marketing): Great 1 I'll fold these edits, upload the updated draft by EOD, and if no other blockers we'll hand to comms for final copy lock tomorrow morning. :rocket:
